t: Makita DHP490SFX2 18V combi drill and drill bit set provides heavy-duty drilling and screwdriving power for various materials. Designed for carpenters, plumbers, and general trade professionals working on demanding site installations. Features a brushless motor which delivers high efficiency and longer runtime, reducing maintenance needs. The compact 171mm tool length allows easy access into tight spaces and awkward corners, whilst the lightweight design and soft-grip rubber handle offer easy handling and user comfort during prolonged use. Fan-cooled motor prevents overheating to extend tool life. Also equipped with a variable speed trigger for full control during drilling, electronic brake providing quick stops for safety, and 2-speed gearbox for switching between high speed and high torque. Supplied with 1 x 3.0Ah LXT lithium-ion battery, charger, extensive drill bit accessory set, and blow-moulded carry case.
